name: WTT - Head and Voice Selector
teaser: Customize your character's voice and head appearance post-creation using new dropdown boxes in the Overall panel.
description:
Mod Information

Head and Voice Selector

This mod duplicates the clothing dropdowns in the Overall panel, and re-codes them to work exactly like the Head and Voice dropdowns during character creation, allowing you to alter your character’s head and voice post-creation. With its server-side component, your modifications save to your server profile, ensuring persistent customization across sessions.

This works EXACTLY like the ones used during character creation. You only have options that are available to the player, and to your faction. I replicated the dropdowns to a tee in order for them to work this way, so this won’t give you access to locked heads/voices, or ones not available to your faction. If you want more head/voice options, we strongly recommend RaiRai’s All The Clothes.

No more regretting not picking the Josh voice! Or having to restart your profile to change your head when someone drops a pack of character head and voice selections!

This is the first standalone mod released by the WTT dev team.

I made this specifically for our overhaul, but deemed it *way too cool* to not release standalone. We also may or may not have some more content packs planned to hold you guys over until we feel ready for an actual release. Stay tuned!

What is WTT?

What is Welcome To Tarkov?

Welcome To Tarkov (WTT) is a mod for SPT AKI that has been in development for over a year. What started as a small passion project has grown in size to incorporate 10+ core members as well as contributions from other well-known mod authors and friends of WTT alike.

How does Welcome To Tarkov change the game?

As a mod, WTT overhauls SPT AKI, touching on almost every vanilla game system, as well as adding completely new systems to the game and its core mechanics. Inspired by open-world hardcore survival projects like STALKER: Anomaly and STALKER: GAMMA, WTT takes SPT’s artificial multiplayer MMO difficulty adders and replaces them with a challenging world economy, loot scarcity rebalancing, a lore friendly quest overhaul, and a map-traveling system built from rewritten portions of the Traveler mod allowing seamless travel between maps. Aside from its changes to the game’s core properties, WTT also adds to the world’s variety of traders, NPC’s, characters, items, and quests:

  • Over 500 custom bundles adding new weapons, attachments, wearables, containers, food, medical, and barter items.
  • New bosses with their own custom gear that will be properly incorporated into WTT’s quest lines.
  • New, meaningful traders with their own lore-friendly quests and narrative elements to help the player progress through the story-line of WTT.
  • New playable characters and outfits that will add to the player’s customization abilities.
  • New quest types incorporating brand new map extraction points, putting the player’s knowledge and familiarization of SPT’s maps to the test.

Welcome To Tarkov stands as one of the largest mods created for SPT AKI thus far.

versions.description:
Fixes an issue with the dropdowns not working if an unavailable head/voice is in use. This is usually encountered when using a profile editor to use a boss head/voice.

With an unavailable head/voice equipped, it will appear at the top of the dropdown. If you change back to one normally available, it will disappear after a raid or game restart.

Voice preview will not play when re-selecting an unavailable voice.
